title: triage-output
description: The ONLY shape the support-triage workflow will act on. A model response is not trusted because it parsed — it is trusted because it conforms to this. Kept as a file so the contract is reviewable and diffable on its own; the workflow's parser embeds a copy, and a test asserts the two never drift.

category.description: Routing destination. A closed set: an unknown category cannot be routed, so it must fail validation rather than be forwarded to a queue that does not exist.

urgency.description: Closed set. A model that returns 7 or "very high" here must be rejected, not coerced — coercion is how a critical ticket silently becomes a normal one.

summary.description: One-line summary shown to a human. Bounded so a runaway response cannot be written into a UI field verbatim.

requires_human.description: Strictly boolean. "probably" is not a decision an automated router can act on.
